newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares dip at start, seen recovering.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares dip at start, seen recovering.

text.p: Danish share prices slipped slightly in early trade on Tuesday but dealers expected recovery ahead bolstered by Wall Street gains, the strong dollar and falling bond yields in a rather thin market.

"Turnover will probably remain low but the U.S. Dow rise should help us advance today. Although there is a dearth of corporate news, the afternoon's key American first quarter GDP data could affect things," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.42 point to 155.84 at 0720 gmt, having closed 0.44 point lower on Monday.
